source.title: On some results and open problems concerning Armendariz rings

trace.notes: Normalized the single input URL https://zbmath.org/6525813 as a zbMATH resolver record. Direct fetch of the zbMATH web page returned a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH API was used only to identify the exact work, title, authors, zbMATH identifier 1333.16024, DOI 10.1142/S1793557115500746, and source details; no open problems were extracted from metadata.

Crossref confirmed the same DOI and title and exposed the World Scientific landing page https://www.worldscientific.com/doi/abs/10.1142/S1793557115500746 plus PDF candidate https://www.worldscientific.com/doi/pdf/10.1142/S1793557115500746. OpenAlex confirmed the same DOI and title but reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted with blocked_or_challenged publisher access. The World Scientific DOI landing page and PDF endpoint returned Cloudflare 403 challenges. Exact-work search candidates inspected were metadata-only or bibliographic pages, including an author-profile page and Altai State Pedagogical University historical/bibliography pages that cite the work but do not contain the article's problem statements. Because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source was recovered, extraction stopped.
Saved the final JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/6525813.json and outputs/latest.json.
